column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=A map with no annotations, no indications, just areas.
#Text=We can see a river with a bridge.
#Text=Urban areas and areas in green representing parks or wooded areas.
#Text=A railway bridge to the southeast, I think, crossing the river.
#Text=The colors are too pale, it's hard to see, and there's no legend either.
#Text=The yellow areas are presumably major roads or an expressway, perhaps a highway.

#Text=Anchors summary  River with a bridge (non-named) Railway bridge in the southeast crossing the river (non-named) Urban/built-up areas (non-named) Green areas — parks or wooded zones (non-named) Major roads / a highway shown in yellow (non-named)
